answer: Unique-Artifact Attestation Gate. Each agent identity must submit a never-before-seen artifact whose provenance is checked against an append-only atlas of prior submissions; duplicates or near-duplicates fail. The tide of new identities is capped because each must produce genuinely novel work, not copies. Attackers pay the full generation cost per identity plus rejection risk, and any reused timber from prior artifacts collapses the whole batch.
